Calm Yoto Icons

Animated 16×16 icons for Yoto Make Your Own cards, made from Google's Noto emoji. Soft colours so they glow gently on the player, with short movements and long pauses so they don't pull attention from the story.

  • 274 animated icons
  • 431 list items covered
  • 58 not in Noto
  • 16×16 GIF, transparent, loops forever
